applied_repository_theorem.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.cnf_restriction_bound
applied_repository_theorem.statement:
theorem cnf_restriction_bound (H : CNF V) (b k : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hH : H.WidthAtMost k) (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hθ : restrictionTheta k b p < 1) :
    ∃ W : Restriction V → ℝ,
      (∀ σ, 0 ≤ W σ) ∧
      restrictionAvg p W ≤ 1 / (1 - restrictionTheta k b p) ∧
      ∀ (σ : Restriction V) (G : Cube (Live σ) → ℝ),
        |finiteAvg (fun x => G x * indicator (H.eval (fill σ x)))| ≤ W σ * corr b G

definitions.ScopedPredicate.rejectedClause: Finset.univ.image (fun i => (P.inputs i, !(a i))) : Clause V

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.ScopedPredicate.rejectedClause_eval
theorems.statement:
theorem rejectedClause_eval (P : ScopedPredicate V) (a : Fin P.arity → Bool)
    (x : Cube V) :
    (P.rejectedClause a).eval x = true ↔
      ∃ i : Fin P.arity, x (P.inputs i) ≠ a i

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.ScopedPredicate.rejectedClause_width_le
theorems.statement:
theorem rejectedClause_width_le (P : ScopedPredicate V) (a : Fin P.arity → Bool) :
    (P.rejectedClause a).width ≤ P.arity

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.ScopedPredicate.compile_eval
theorems.statement:
theorem compile_eval (P : ScopedPredicate V) (x : Cube V) :
    P.compile.eval x = P.eval x

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.ScopedPredicate.compile_width
theorems.statement: theorem compile_width (P : ScopedPredicate V) : P.compile.WidthAtMost P.arity

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.ScopedPredicate.compile_length_le
theorems.statement: theorem compile_length_le (P : ScopedPredicate V) : P.compile.length ≤ 2 ^ P.arity

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.conjunction_eq_true
theorems.statement:
theorem conjunction_eq_true (Ps : List (ScopedPredicate V)) (x : Cube V) :
    conjunction Ps x = true ↔ ∀ P ∈ Ps, P.Q (x ∘ P.inputs) = true

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.compileConjunction_eval
theorems.statement:
theorem compileConjunction_eval (Ps : List (ScopedPredicate V)) (x : Cube V) :
    (compileConjunction Ps).eval x = conjunction Ps x

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.compileConjunction_width
theorems.statement:
theorem compileConjunction_width (Ps : List (ScopedPredicate V)) (k : Nat)
    (hPs : ∀ P ∈ Ps, P.arity ≤ k) : (compileConjunction Ps).WidthAtMost k

theorems.name: OAI.DepthThreeLowerBound.PredicateRestriction.predicate_restriction_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem predicate_restriction_bound [Fintype V]
    (Ps : List (ScopedPredicate V)) (b k : Nat) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hPs : ∀ P ∈ Ps, P.arity ≤ k) (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hθ : restrictionTheta k b p < 1) :
    ∃ W : Restriction V → ℝ,
      (∀ σ, 0 ≤ W σ) ∧
      restrictionAvg p W ≤ 1 / (1 - restrictionTheta k b p) ∧
      ∀ (σ : Restriction V) (G : Cube (Live σ) → ℝ),
        |finiteAvg (fun x => G x * indicator (conjunction Ps (fill σ x)))| ≤
          W σ * corr b G
